steps.name: Select remaining producer artifacts without rewriting evidence
steps.run:
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
source = Path('release-producer-artifacts')
destination = Path('evidence')
if source.is_symlink() or not source.is_dir() or destination.is_symlink():
    raise ValueError('Evidence staging requires ordinary directories')
artifacts = sorted(source.iterdir())
if any(path.is_symlink() or not path.is_dir() for path in artifacts):
    raise ValueError('Producer artifact must be an ordinary directory')
selected = [path for path in artifacts if path.name != 'regression'
            and not path.name.startswith(('regression-', 'gallery-'))]
if any((destination / path.name).exists() or (destination / path.name).is_symlink()
       for path in selected):
    raise ValueError('Refusing to overwrite retained evidence')
destination.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
for path in selected:
    path.rename(destination / path.name)
PY
